title: Coolant Flow Loss — Emergency Stop
description: Coolant flow P030 = {val} L/min (below minimum 5 L/min). Coolant tank level P033 = {val2}%. Machine stopped to prevent tool and workpiece thermal damage.
probable_cause: Coolant pump failure, blocked filter, ruptured hose, or empty tank.
diagnostic_steps: Check coolant supply hose for kinking or rupture
Inspect coolant filter element differential pressure
remedy: Restore coolant supply. Replace pump if failed. Do not restart machining until minimum flow P030 >15 L/min confirmed.
required_action: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorised technician inspection.
escalation_path: If CLS-CR-001 is not addressed (immediate machine stop. do not restart without authorised technician inspection.), the fault will escalate in this order: CLS-MJ-001, then SPN-MJ-003, then CLS-SR-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
